body.prose: Then it's up to the integration if you can manipulate the [holons] or not. Because in Git, I'm not sure you should be able to. Because the thing with Git is that it has its own commits. And the commits in Git is means that the file was at a certain commit when your [holon] pointed to it at that commit. So integrations may be for atomic sources, and I'm not sure if you then can mutate it there . You can actually mutate a file in Git. I don't know, and I don't even know if the file's content is to be shown. Maybe the file's content is to be shown in the [holon]. Or you're still just given only a link. But then you're given the actual address so that you can still look up the content. So if you're in the UI, then might still be able to do that, but that causes extra side effects. So maybe that's not what you want. But in the example of [Git] and files, maybe you want to give the experience of being able to edit a file with the field, but then it's an unstaged change, but then there's commits in the field. I don't know. Getting a bit confused there.
